free_tier.stated: no free tier; VPS XL is EUR 79.00/month including 19% VAT, and the first three months of a 12-month term are EUR 48.00/month including VAT

retention.stated: the disk persists for the contract term; the 12-month table prices the first three months at EUR 48.00 and the rest at EUR 79.00

egress.terms: unlimited traffic on a port up to 1,000 Mbit/s; no byte quota or rate is published

interface_detail: RDP over a public IPv4; no public API is documented on the page read
tooling: any RDP client; the provider's control panel
chaining: 8 vCPU and 16 GiB for about USD 74 net a month, which is the cheapest German-market row whose licence is bundled rather than itemised

limits.value: traffic is called unlimited and no rate is published

limits_note: prices are printed including 19% VAT; the 1-month table adds EUR 9.00 setup, the 6-month table has no setup line, and the 12-month table has no setup line
binding_note: the 1 Gbit/s port is the first hard ceiling; traffic is unlimited without a published rate.

identity_cost.detail: an account and a payment method at order; the order flow is account-gated and its instrument list was not read

confidence_note: the shape, the VAT-inclusive prices and the term tables are printed on the page read. The licence is included on the evidence of the same hardware costing EUR 39.00 on the Linux page against EUR 79.00 on the Windows page, a EUR 40.00 gap; the page does not itemise it.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'VPS XL 8 vCores 480 GB NVMe Storage 16 GB RAM 48 EUR/Mon. Aktion fuer 3 Monate danach 79 EUR/Mon.' and 'Preise inkl. MwSt.'
the term tables print EUR 79.00 on the 1-month table with EUR 9.00 setup, and EUR 48.00 for months 1 to 3 of the 12-month table followed by EUR 79.00
the same VPS XL hardware is EUR 39.00 on the Linux page, a EUR 40.00 gap against the Windows price that is consistent with a bundled licence

notes: The EUR 79.00 is VAT-inclusive, so a buyer outside the EU pays the net EUR 66.39 if the reverse-charge rule applies; both figures are recorded because the tax basis is not established. The EUR 48.00 first-quarter rate is a promo; the steady rate is EUR 79.00 including VAT.

extras.vat_note: 19% German VAT is included in the printed price; a non-EU buyer may pay the net figure, which was not confirmed at checkout
extras.windows_licence: included; derived from the EUR 40.00 Linux-to-Windows gap
